question: How must the firmly resolved practitioner treat this extracted teaching?
premises: This extraction is the subject of the injunction.
The one firmly resolved must always keep it hidden.
inference: The firmly resolved practitioner must always keep this extracted teaching concealed.
uncertainties: Meaning of uddharaṇaṃ as 'extraction/essence' follows context but is interpretive.
plain_english: This extracted teaching must always be kept secret by one who is firmly resolved.
